general.sectionDesc: Control default behavior and workspace layout preferences.
general.defaultScreenDesc: Choose which workspace opens by default.
general.preferRecentPresetDesc: Open the most recently used preset when entering preset-based tools, if available.
general.layoutDesc: Tune left and right sidebar width with preset steps.

language.sectionDesc: Choose your display language for Imify, or manage custom runtime translations.
language.displayLanguageDesc: Select the interface language. Bundled languages fallback to English for missing keys.
language.deleteConfirmDesc: This will permanently remove this custom language. This action cannot be undone.
language.tooltipDeprecated: Translation version {{langVersion}} is outdated (app: {{appVersion}}). Some strings may be missing or fall back to English.

performance.sectionDesc: Smart Concurrency Advisor helps simulate safe worker counts using your hardware profile and active format settings.
performance.advisorDesc: Modern encoders like AVIF and JXL can consume high CPU and memory in browser workers. Enable advisor to get dynamic recommendations based on machine profile and current format options.
performance.privacyNote: Privacy note: hardware data is only read and processed locally in your browser. No telemetry or external upload.
performance.enableAdvisorDesc: Keep manual concurrency free (1-90), but show contextual safe recommendations under Export Settings.
performance.unlockConcurrencyDesc: Allow values up to 90 and bypass Advisor hard lock. This can increase crash risk on heavy formats.
performance.modeStatic: Smart mode is off. Concurrency Advisor is running in static fallback mode using default profile (4 threads, 4GB RAM budget).
performance.modeDanger: Danger mode: overclock is enabled. Heavy formats (AVIF/JXL/PNG tiny+OxiPNG) can hit OOM if you push concurrency too high.
performance.modeSafe: Safe mode: concurrency max is hard-locked by Advisor calculations to reduce crash risk.
performance.pdfStudioLazyPagination: Lazy Load Pages by Pagination (PDF Studio)
performance.pdfStudioLazyPaginationDesc: Only preload thumbnails for pages within the active pagination view to optimize RAM usage (recommended for mobile or large PDF documents).

warnings.sectionDesc: Customize which validation warnings and confirmation dialogs appear during workspace transitions.
warnings.downloadConfirmDesc: Warn before downloading more than {{threshold}} images one by one.
warnings.oomWarningDesc: Warn when selected batch size exceeds ~{{threshold}} MB.
warnings.heavyPreviewWarning: Show Image Splicing high preview quality warning
warnings.heavyPreviewWarningDesc: Warn if there are more than {{count}} images or total area exceeds ~{{pixels}}M px².

usage.sectionDesc: Help us improve Imify by allowing anonymous performance metrics and error reporting.
usage.frequencyDesc: These counters drive the "Most used (stable)" sorting mode.

data.sectionDesc: Manage presets, template definitions, preferences, and database schema version.
data.statsDesc: Overview of your persistent browser storage allocation for Imify presets and store preferences.
data.assetStatsDesc: Detailed view of saved watermarks, downloaded offline AI models, and offline fonts.
data.backupRestoreDesc: Backup presets, templates, settings, and workspace preferences to a JSON file, or restore them from a backup.
data.exportDesc: Select the features you want to export. This file can be used to restore your settings and presets.
data.importDesc: Select a previously exported data file to restore your settings and presets.
data.schemaDesc: Manage and migrate the version of your local database schema.
data.migrateSuccessDesc: Your presets have been unified under Schema v2.0.

shortcuts.sectionDesc: Review and rebind keyboard shortcuts used across preview workspaces and Pattern Generator tools.
shortcuts.shortcutsDesc: Click a shortcut and press a key combination. Press Esc to cancel or Backspace/Delete to clear.
shortcuts.searchPlaceholder: Search by action name or key combination (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+E)
